projection.successRule: false only for execution_error; rejection, stale_basis, unavailable and unknown are domain outcomes, not affirmative execution claims

hostPolicy.completionRoute: new command_ingress-admitted command, not implemented here
hostPolicy.bootstrap: Host binds the conversation to an admitted session; read_model_summary takes no arguments and returns its handle and basis. Handles do not establish identity or authority.
hostPolicy.handles: Host-issued opaque workspace/proposal/run/page handles; scoped to admitted generation and workspace; never filesystem paths. Restart invalidates handles; unavailable/unknown, never redispatch. Cursor binds tool, basis, run and next offset.
hostPolicy.attribution: Host stamps author_type=agent and original conversation/turn/call; never accepts user attribution from tool arguments.
hostPolicy.proposal: Require claimedModelHash == basis.modelHash == current session hash before queue registration. The agent supplies native EditorOperationIntent operation_id, operation_kind, target, change and rationale; the schema closes change_kind and field_path to the admitted set, so no modifiers field, bend realization, bend insertion or library record can be proposed: the person enters every k and SIF. The host stamps operation_status=proposed, author_type=agent, queue_id, source, not-run validation and the constant audit and professional boundary records, and passes the complete native intents to a host-created OperationBatch. No alternate field-edit language. After schema validation the host admits each operation only if its operation_kind, object_type, change_kind and field_path match one admittedOperations row; the summary lists the same kinds. The Rust applier remains the semantic validator, including each kind's object type, field, unit, dimension and before text; it refuses agent-written modifiers. Queue the immutable submission via the existing preview/human apply route.
hostPolicy.completion: Resolve requestRef to the immutable original pending call and require its conversation/turn/call/tool, workspace and application-generation binding. The submitting webview must remain the admitted session. For summary/node reads require unchanged live revision through completion. For queued proposals, observations, solves and result reads validate the host-retained proposal/run record against its captured basis; a later live revision is permitted only as an explicitly historical/applied outcome, never rebased to current. Duplicate or forged completions and wrong/detached sessions are refused. Preserve already admitted application outcome as actual or unknown on loss; never redispatch.
hostPolicy.interruption: Withdraw pending review only; application already admitted yields actual outcome or unknown. Turn interruption is not solve cancellation or rollback.
hostPolicy.limits: Apply the smaller of catalog caps and existing admission budgets before parsing/allocating argument or result payloads; bounded producers, no whole-model serialization followed by truncation.
hostPolicy.results: Use existing permitted view/value-record semantics and redaction floors. No raw private row bypass. Preserve exact decimal where required; withheld/unavailable has no numeric value. A run handle binds its evaluated model hash, never relabel historical results as current.
hostPolicy.autonomy: No apply/accept/release/grant tools. Any later autonomy needs separately authorized host policy and implementation.
hostPolicy.solve: Require claimedModelHash == basis.modelHash == current session hash before handleRun; retain evaluated hash even if run id changes. Return session solverMode, health and run handle; progress only to existing supported notifications/panel.
hostPolicy.proposalContext: Require an explicit bounded assumptions array (empty means none declared), separate from unchanged native operation intents and per-operation rationale. Each assumption has a stable id, statement and existing affected operation ids. Validate id uniqueness and operation membership; capture immutable context with proposal handle, batch id, original attribution and basis. Display it with the queue and retain it with session outcomes/receipts, including reject/withdraw/unknown; do not inject extra fields into native intents or claim durable persistence.
hostPolicy.basisAdmission: Summary has no caller basis. Node reads, proposal submission and solve admission require the current live basis. Proposal observation uses the host-retained proposal basis; result reads use the host-retained evaluated run basis. All require the admitted workspace/application generation. Historical calls are not refused solely because the current model revision advanced.

tools.name: swbpipe_read_records
tools.description: Read a bounded page of one family at the current basis: components, supports, pipe_segments, nodes, materials, sections, load_cases, primitive_loads, combinations, condition_sets, rule_pack_refs or project. Each record has its canonical JSON (recordText) and the exact before texts (before) its admitted edits and deletions need, keyed delete or by field path: objective_connector.hardware|pressure_model (components); configuration, provenance_record (supports); condition_set_ref (pipe_segments); constitutive_properties, temperature_points, expansion_laws (materials); analysis_state, pressure_regions, condition_use, equivalent_static.wind.exposure (load_cases); reference_configurations, model_settings.node_proximity_tolerance, model_settings.shear_model (project). A load case's recordText leaves out analysis_state, pressure_regions and primitive_loads; a primitive_loads record is {load_case, primitive_load}; project is one record, id the project id, recordText {project, model_settings, reference_configurations}. A record over a bound is unavailable, never cut.

tools.name: swbpipe_propose_operations
tools.description: Queue operations as one atomic batch for the person's review; never applies them. Steps apply in order, so later steps may name ids created earlier. Send only operation_id, operation_kind, target, change, rationale; the host stamps the rest. Use the summary's basis and hash. after is JSON text; quantities are {value, unit}; every record needs id, label (not primitive loads) and provenance (the person's stated source). Arguments are capped at the summary's argumentBytes, so an operation with a long after (an analysis state) travels alone in its proposal. Kinds as operation_kind/object_type/change_kind/field_path [unit; dimension; before]. before: not_present for a new record or absent member; b.X is read_records before.X; rec is recordText; a scalar field takes its stored value from rec (a number as stored, a vector as "x, y, z unit", text or an id, ids joined by ", ") or TBD when absent. Project, target.ref projectId: modify/Project/set_project_unit/project.units.<length|force|moment|pressure|stress|temperature|angle> [the after symbol; the key; summary projectUnits value or not_present] after a catalog symbol (length is locked once nodes exist); modify/Project/set_model_setting/model_settings.node_proximity_tolerance [length unit; length; b.X] after number text, model_settings.shear_model [none; dimensionless; b.X] after euler_bernoulli|timoshenko_annulus_energy_v1 (pressure-free only); modify/Model/set_field/reference_configurations [none; dimensionless; b.X] (exact route) [{id, label, geometry_ref {kind "authored_model_geometry"}, member_references [{pipe_ref, basis {kind "temperature_reference", installation_temperature}, fit {kind "none"}, provenance}], provenance}]. create/Material/create_material/materials [project stress unit; stress; not_present]: elastic_modulus and either shear_modulus or constitutive_basis "homogeneous_isotropic_E_nu_v1" with poisson_ratio (unit "1"); optional thermal_expansion_coefficient (1/degC). modify/Material/set_field: elastic_modulus.value|shear_modulus.value [unit; stress; number], thermal_expansion_coefficient.value [unit; thermal_expansion_coefficient; number] after {value, unit}; constitutive_properties [none; dimensionless; b.X] {constitutive_basis, elastic_modulus, poisson_ratio|shear_modulus, thermal_expansion_coefficient, provenance}; temperature_points [none; dimensionless; b.X] [{id, temperature, elastic_modulus, poisson_ratio|shear_modulus, thermal_expansion_coefficient, provenance}]; expansion_laws [none; dimensionless; b.X] (exact route) [{id, definition "engineering_secant", datum_temperature, data {kind "constant", coefficient}, provenance}]. create/Section/create_section/sections [its length unit; length; not_present]: name, section_type "pipe", properties {outside_diameter, wall_thickness}. modify/Element/assign_section/section_ref [none; dimensionless; rec] after {"section_ref": id}. modify/Element/set_field/material [none; dimensionless; id] after a material id; section.<outside_diameter|wall_thickness|corrosion_allowance|mill_tolerance|insulation_thickness>.value [unit; length; number or TBD] and section.<material_density|contents_density|insulation_density>.value [unit; density; number or TBD] after {value, unit}; a bound pipe's diameter and wall change only through its section. connect/Element/connect_pipe_run/pipe_segments [length unit; length; not_present]: from, to, material, y_reference {x,y,z} (not parallel), section {outside_diameter, wall_thickness, corrosion_allowance before exact route; optional mill_tolerance, material_density, contents_density, insulation_thickness, insulation_density}. insert/Component/insert_component_symbol/components [none; dimensionless; not_present]: kind, node, geometry. bend: bend_pipe_ref, bend_radius, bend_angle, bend_geometry_source_reference. tee: branch_header_pipe_ref, branch_branch_pipe_ref, branch_run_size, branch_header_size, branch_connection_angle, branch_connection_type, branch_reinforcement_reference, branch_geometry_source_reference. reducer/valve/flange: rigid_pipe_ref, rigid_body_length, end_a_size, end_b_size, weight, center_of_gravity {x,y,z,unit}, connection_end_a_reference, connection_end_b_reference, stiffness_behavior_reference, rigid_component_source_reference; reducer eccentric_offset {x,y,z,unit} must equal its pipe's transverse node separation. expansion_joint: pressure-free mechanics_interface {solver_consumption "not_solver_consumed"}; exact route objective_connector (ask the person for its stiffness, axes and offsets). modify/Component/set_field/geometry.<member> [quantity unit, else none; angle for bend_angle and branch_connection_angle, force for weight, area for effective_area, length for other quantities and vectors, else dimensionless; stored value or TBD] quantities after {value, unit}, center_of_gravity and eccentric_offset {x,y,z,unit}, references and text as plain text. modify/Component/set_field/objective_connector.hardware|pressure_model [none; dimensionless; b.X]. create/Support/create_support/supports [none; dimensionless; not_present]: node, restraints (at least one of UX..RZ), family (anchor, guide, line_stop, vertical_support, spring, variable_spring_hanger, spring_hanger, constant_effort_support, nonlinear), optional stiffness {dof, value}, hanger, nonlinear {behavior gap|lift_off|one_way|friction, dof (not linearly restrained), initial_state, gap+closes_when | contact_when | active_when | friction_coefficient+normal_reaction_source}. modify/Support/update_support/configuration [none; dimensionless; b.X]: whole new configuration; provenance_record [none; dimensionless; b.X] the hanger selection's record object. create/Load/create_load_case/load_cases [none; dimensionless; not_present]: non-empty kind and status (the reference system uses "primitive_user_load", "draft"), primitive_loads []. create/Load/create_primitive_load/primitive_loads, target.ref the case [magnitude unit; its dimension; not_present]: category thermal (element pipe, global_x, temperature_interval), distributed_force (element pipe, global_x|y|z, force_per_length), concentrated_force (node, global_x|y|z, force), concentrated_moment (node, rotation_x|y|z, moment), weight (node, global_x|y|z force or rotation_x|y|z moment), imposed_displacement (support+dof, direction = dof, displacement|rotation). modify/Load/update_load, exact route: pressure_regions [none; dimensionless; b.X] [] or [{id, member_pipe_ids, member_connector_ids, pressure_basis "internal_differential_zero_external_v1", pressure, terminals [two {node_ref, closure_transfer transfers_to_wall|separately_supported_or_compensated, provenance}], provenance}]; analysis_state [none; dimensionless; b.X] {contract "openpipestress.load_reference_state/1.0.0", reference_configuration_ref, element_states [{pipe_ref, operating_temperature, material_selection {kind exact_point|temperature_interpolation, material_ref, point_ref|temperature, interpolation, extrapolation}, thermal_state {kind, expansion_law_ref}}], support_states [{support_ref, participation {kind}, boundary_motion [{dof, meaning, value}]}], load_sources [{source_ref, factor}], history {kind}, provenance} (after not_present removes it). Replacing a stored state is two proposals in order, each alone: its removal, then the new state; declare in each proposal's assumptions that they are one replacement, on the removal that the case has no analysis state until the next proposal is applied and that a solve in between refuses the case (LOAD_STATE_ANALYSIS_STATE_REQUIRED), and tell the person the same; equivalent_static.wind.exposure [none; dimensionless; b.X] {exposed_pipe_refs, exposed_spans}. modify/Load/set_field/equivalent_static.seismic.gravity_acceleration.value [unit; acceleration], .seismic.g_factor_<x|y|z>.value and .wind.shape_factor.value [none; dimensionless], .wind.pressure.value [unit; pressure] after {value, unit}; .wind.direction global_x|y|z and .wind.exposed_pipe_refs ids joined by "," [none; dimensionless]; before the stored value or TBD. create/Combination/create_combination/combinations [none; dimensionless; not_present]: label, basis result_state_subtraction {minuend_id, subtrahend_id} | range_envelope {operand_ids, mode min|max|min_abs|max_abs} | mechanics|absolute_sum|srss {terms [{load_case, factor}], at least one}, provenance. create/Combination/create_combination_term/terms, target.ref the combination [none; dimensionless; not_present]: {load_case, factor}. create/ConditionSet/create_condition_set/condition_sets [none; dimensionless; not_present]: {id, label, installation_temperature, conditions [{key, temperature}], added_weight {magnitude, direction}, exposure {wind}, provenance}; modify/ConditionSet/update_condition_set/condition_sets [none; dimensionless; rec] the whole record; modify/Element/assign_condition_set/condition_set_ref [none; dimensionless; b.X] after {"condition_set_ref": id} or not_present; modify/Load/set_load_case_condition_use/condition_use [none; dimensionless; b.X] {temperature key, added_weight, wind_exposure} (pressure-free only). create/RulePackRef/add_rule_pack_ref/rule_pack_refs, target.ref its rule_pack_id [none; dimensionless; not_present]: the pack's identity record. Deletes delete/<type>/delete_component|delete_material|delete_section|delete_support|delete_pipe_run|delete_node|delete_load_case|delete_combination|delete_condition_set|remove_rule_pack_ref [none; dimensionless; b.delete] after "deleted" (component, material, section) or "not_present"; refused while referenced. Exact route: modify/Model/set_field/pressure_profile, target.ref projectId [none; dimensionless; summary pressureProfileBefore]: {schema_version, pressure_contract {version "3.0.0", mode "exact_pressure_v3", shear_model}}; set it before any load case exists, or after every case has pressure_regions; then each case needs pressure_regions ([] when unpressurized). Build in phases of at most the summary's operation limit, each applied before the next: units and profile; materials and sections; geometry; components; supports; loads; reference configuration, states and combinations. Never author k or SIF: right after the components phase, ask the person to realize each bend (Insert bend at corner) and enter k, SIFs and their source, and tee modifiers; supports and loads must not attach to a corner before. On the exact route a solve is refused until every bend is realized; on the pressure-free route an unrealized bend solves as a straight chord (k does not affect chord stiffness; a supplied positive scalar SIF applies to the chord, and without one no intensified measure is published), and you must say so when reporting.
